title: Case: Recipient needs a defined delivery slot rather than an all-day estimate
context: A small appliance is booked on an all-day service. Larkspire must quote available timed slots and confirm the customer’s acceptance of any charge.
initial_request: I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-008: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
